ITEM 1 | Orange cooked vegetable pieces, roughly 15-20 pieces, cut into wedge/spear shapes about 4-6 cm long and 1-2 cm thick, slightly glossy with a glazed, soft-looking surface, some with browned edges, piled in a mound in the center-right of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Single orange cooked piece, elongated oval slice about 4 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, glossy and smooth, lying flat on the plate separate from the pile at the lower left | 12
ITEM 3 | Small round orange disc about 2 cm across, smooth and glossy, lying alone at the upper edge of the pile | 4
